snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Continue (or begin!) your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure with Stonethorn, a new DLC dungeon pack coming soon to The Elder Scrolls Online. Assault an ancient fortress and halt a new vampiric invasion before it begins its march, and investigate the terrible creations of the mad alchemist Arkasis. What you discover shall not only have repercussions for the people of Skyrim, but all of Tamriel!

The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn arrives August 24 for PC/Mac and Stadia* and September 1 for Xbox One and PlayStation 4.
*Available only in limited territories.

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TESOnline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Sexual Themes, Use of Alcohol, and Violence. Online interactions not rated by the ESRB.
